operations.description:
Claims a device for a customer and adds it to zero-touch enrollment. If the
device is already claimed by another customer, the call returns an error.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] androiddeviceprovisioning partners devices claim [PATH] partners devices claim [PARAMS] access alt callback fields id key oauth partner pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] claim device identifier metadata request response

operations.description:
Claims a batch of devices for a customer asynchronously. Adds the devices
to zero-touch enrollment. To learn more, read [Long‑running batch
operations](/zero-touch/guides/how-it-works#operations).
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] androiddeviceprovisioning partners devices claim async [PATH] partners devices claim async [PARAMS] access alt callback fields id key oauth partner pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] claim device devices identifier metadata operation partner request

operations.description:
Finds devices claimed for customers. The results only contain devices
registered to the reseller that's identified by the `partnerId` argument.
The customer's devices purchased from other resellers don't appear in the
results.

operations](/zero-touch/guides/how-it-works#operations).
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] androiddeviceprovisioning partners devices update metadata async [PATH] partners devices update metadata async [PARAMS] access alt callback fields id key oauth partner pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] arguments batch device identifier in metadata operation request update

operations.description:
Creates a new configuration. Once created, a customer can apply the
configuration to devices.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] androiddeviceprovisioning customers configurations create [PATH] configurations [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] configuration

operations.description:
Creates a customer for zero-touch enrollment. After the method returns
successfully, admin and owner roles can manage devices and EMM configs
by calling API methods or using their zero-touch enrollment portal.
The customer receives an email that welcomes them to zero-touch enrollment
and explains how to sign into the portal.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] androiddeviceprovisioning partners customers create [PATH] customers [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] company create customer request

operations.description:
Applies a Configuration to the device to register the device for zero-touch
enrollment. After applying a configuration to a device, the device
automatically provisions itself on first boot, or next factory reset.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] androiddeviceprovisioning customers devices apply configuration [PATH] devices apply configuration [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] apply configuration customer device identifier reference request

operations.description: Removes a configuration from device.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] androiddeviceprovisioning customers devices remove configuration [PATH] devices remove configuration [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] configuration customer device identifier reference remove request

operations.description:
Unclaims a device from a customer and removes it from zero-touch
enrollment.

After removing a device, a customer must contact their reseller to register
the device into zero-touch enrollment again.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] androiddeviceprovisioning customers devices unclaim [PATH] devices unclaim [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] customer device identifier reference request unclaim
